name: September 24, 2024 Regular Meeting
minutes_text:
MINUTES
  MALIBU ARTS COMMISSION
  REGULAR MEETING
  SEPTEMBER 24, 2024
  CITY HALL, MULTIPURPOSE ROOM
  9:30 A.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Chair Lawrence called the meeting to order at 9:43 am.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Chair Fireball Lawrence; Vice Chair Julia Holland; and Commissioners Barry
  Haldeman and Peter Jones; and Ex-Officio Graeme Clifford

  ABSENT: Commissioner Lotte Cherin

  ALSO PRESENT: Kristin Riesgo, Community Services Director; and Brittany Saleaumua,
  Administrative Assistant

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Commissioner Jones moved, and Chair Lawrence seconded a motion to approve
  the agenda. The question was called, and the motion carried 4-0; Commissioner
  Cherin absent.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Administrative Assistant Saleaumua reported the meeting agenda was properly posted on
  September l9, 2024.

ITEM 1.  CEREMONIAL/PRESENTATIONS

  None.

ITEM 2.A.  WRITTEN AND ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC

  None.

ITEM 2.B.  COMMISSION AD HOC COMMITTEE REPORTS

  1.  Arts in Education

  Community Services Director Riesgo stated poetry workshops at Malibu
  Middle School would begin in October.
   Malibu Arts COmmissiOn Regular Meeting
  Minutes of September 24, 2024
  Page 2 of 4

  Vice Chair Holland stated Poet Laureate Nathan Hassall has been doing a
  wonderful job.

  2.  Malibu Public Art Exhibitions

  Chair Lawrence stated the Derek Schimming Retrospective Exhibition
  gallery opening occurred on September l4, 2024. He encouraged
  Commissioners to attend the art exhibition opening receptions.

  Vice Chair Holland suggested adding information to the flyers regarding
  the musicians that play during the opening reception.

  3.  Business and CommunitV Outreach

  Commissioner Haldeman suggested meeting Santa Monica or Culver City
  Commissioners to explore new art ideas and events.

  4.  Social Media

  In response to Chair Lawrence, Community Services Director Riesgo stated
  that the Commission would review the ad hoc committees in January 2025.

ITEM 3  CONSENT CALENDAR

MOTION  Chair Lawrence moved, and Vice Chair Holland seconded a motion to approve the
  Consent Calendar. The question was called, and the motion carried 4—0;
  Commissioner Cherin absent.

  The Consent Calendar consisted of the following items:

  A.  Previously Discussed Items
  None.
  B.  New Items
  1. Approval ofMinutes
  Recommended Action: Approve the minutes for the September 26, 2023
  Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting.

ITEM 4  OLD BUSINESS

  None.

ITEM 5  NEW BUSINESS

  Malibu Arts Commission Assignments
  Recommended Action: l) Review the Malibu Arts Commission Assignments; and
  2) Evaluate and prioritize the Assignments to accomplish in Fiscal Year 2024-25.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting
  Minutes of September 24, 2024
  Page 3 of 4

  Community Services Director Riesgo presented the staff report.

  Commissioner Haldeman stated that assignments should be listed by priority.

  Vice Chair Holland stated the creative directory should be a priority.

  In response to Vice Chair Holland, Community Services Director Riesgo stated an
  online form could be created for artist submissions.

  Chair Lawrence suggested adding the completed creative directory to the
  Commission website.

  Commissioner Jones stated the artists' artwork, website, biography, and history
  should be data in the creative directory.

CONSENSUS
  By Consensus, the Commission prioritized the development of a Malibu creative
  directory as a high priority.

  B.  Arts Marketing
  Recommended Action: Review and provide feedback on the marketing strategies
  of art programs and events.

  Community Services Director Riesgo presented the staff report.

  Commissioner Haldeman suggested placing signs at the end of Stuart Ranch Road
  to promote the opening art reception of the Malibu City Gallery.

  Chair Lawrence suggested hosting a booth at the Malibu Farmers Market.

  In response to Commissioner Haldeman, Community Services Director Riesgo
  stated the Quarterly Recreation Guide and City Newsletter included art exhibitions,
  programs, and poetry events. She stated staff had designed and printed banners that
  would be placed on the Ioki property the day of the exhibition opening receptions.

ITEM 6  STAFF UPDATES

  Community Services Director Riesgo provided an update on poetry programs and
  the Malibu Film Society. She reminded the Commission they could assist staffwith
  promoting art programs and events at the Malibu Farmers Market on October 13.
  She stated Poet Laureate Nathan Hassall would read poetry at the Fanners Market.

  In response to Commissioner Haldeman, Chair Lawrence stated giveaways such as
  writing pens or mugs should be provided.
   Malibu Arts Commission Regular Meeting

  Page 4 of 4

ITEM 7  COMMISSIONER REPORTS, COMMENTS AND INQUIRIES

  None

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

  Creative Directory

ADJOURNMENT

  At 11:15 a.m., Chair Lawrence adjourned the meeting.
